newsitem.title: USA: Father suspected of killing children dead in pond.
newsitem.headline: Father suspected of killing children dead in pond.

text.p: The body of a man who police say killed his son and three stepchildren while they slept was pulled from an icy pond near this northwestern South Carolina city Tuesday.
The man, Johnny Satterwhite, had left his estranged wife Brenda a note saying "Merry Christmas, bitch" after he apparently shot all the children to death in their beds.

He drowned in a reservoir spillway hours after asking a friend to tell his wife he had left four packages for her in their Laurens home, police said. No information was available on whether his death was accidental or a suicide.

Brenda Satterwhite found the bodies of her children -- Mary Gary, 16, Terrance Gary, 14, Johnny Gary, 13, and Christopher Satterwhite, 10 -- in their beds. Each had been shot twice in the head with a .22 calibre handgun while they slept. Autopsy results on the children, released Tuesday, showed they all died from the wounds.
A .22 calibre gun was found on a living room coffee table beside a note from Satterwhite to his wife saying: "Merry Christmas. bitch. I hope you're satisfied. You'll be along in '97."
Mrs. Satterwhite left the family home 10 days ago. Friends said her husband abused, her that but she felt he would not harm the children.
Satterwhite, a mill worker, drowned, an autopsy showed.
A county employee noticed his brown truck beside the spillway Monday morning. Rescue workers pulled the body from the water after a 40-minute search.
